//: The docs site's scripts (docs/assets/live/*.js, docs/assets/site.js) are checked against the types the Rust code generates: docs/assets/live/engine-wire.d.ts (the browser engine's answers, dt-web), docs/assets/shots/shots.d.ts (shots.json, xtask) and js/api.d.ts (the program's map). A file is checked when it says `// @ts-check` at the top; the site's scripts all do. The site serves the page's code at `../../editor/js` and `../../editor/vendor` (one URL for web/preview/js and vendor), which is not a folder of the repo: `rootDirs` makes tsc read those imports from web/preview, so the types of what the site imports are the page's real ones. `npm test` runs this beside tsconfig.json.
